articles.title: FDI inflows to India jumped 44% in 2025; but greenfield investment suffered: UN
articles.summary: India significantly boosted its foreign direct investment (FDI) in 2025, attracting $39 billion. This represents a substantial 44% increase compared to the previous year, as highlighted by the 2026 World Investment Report. This robust FDI inflow indicates growing international investor confidence in India's economy, contributing to national growth and development, crucial for an aspiring global power.
